source_accounting.colombia_area_share: 94/1122, partial area; complete Nariño (64) and Chocó (30) cohorts

overlap_findings.bolivia_admin_roster: The retained 110-feature BOL ADM2 source accounts for 108 direct province locations and the two source predecessors Cordillera and Velasco through nine physical portions. No source admin feature is left unaccounted; however, the 9 portions are not official administrative provinces.
overlap_findings.ecoregion_partition: Five RESOLVE ecoregions intersect the source Cordillera province and four intersect Velasco. The union of relevant original ecoregion features after source-province clipping covers the valid source province area to numerical precision. Current Atlas portions form the same 9-pair expected internal adjacency graph, but the current union has an equal-area symmetric difference of 393.56 km² (0.47%) for Cordillera and 200.77 km² (0.29%) for Velasco. Per-fragment current/source-intersection coverage ranges 93.30–99.83%; review scale/precision before any future geometry proposal. OGR ST_MakeValid was used only in temporary overlays because raw source/current ecoregion polygons contain invalid topology; source bytes remain unchanged.
overlap_findings.role_classification: For the 9 portions, RESOLVE describes ecoregions as natural ecological assemblages with boundaries based on ecological processes rather than political units. The nine current Atlas metadata rows nevertheless cite the ecoregion ECO_ID as source and declare Province role/admin-selection rationale. This is a supported metadata/semantic correction-needed finding; no location, hierarchy, footprint or live record is changed by this packet.
overlap_findings.complete_area_purpose: Bolivia owns 117 current children across all 9 department parent groups: 108 official-source province polygons plus nine ecoregion-by-province physical fragments that replace two predecessor province polygons. Colombia is a partial area, with the 94 assigned municipalities forming two full department cohorts. The issue workload is not a new geographic partition.

neighbor_summary.limits: Exact-segment equality is not an overlay/cross-border source certificate; sources for adjacent Ecuador, Panama, Brazil, Peru, Argentina, Paraguay and Chile were not row-by-row boundary matched in this packet.

physical_summary.point_screen_limits: GSHHG 2017 global shoreline records are physical-land screening only; they do not certify whole boundaries, island names, settlement sets, lake hydrography, political status or all disconnected components.
